propositions: A new glob-triggered advisory code-review overlay named surface-parity must be added to OVERLAY_IDS and criteria_routing.json to flag when a write-op parameter, guard, or required-field surface changes on one adapter (_lib_writes.py, _commands/, _mcp_writes.py) without corresponding updates to sibling adapters.

The surface-parity overlay must be wired into the four-pass code-review gate (round_a and round_b batches) so the finder is actually dispatched when diffs touch write-surface adapter files, not merely registered as an inert flag.

The overlay must be configured as advisory (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95) with false-positive guards in the reviewer prompt to allow justified deliberate divergences, adapter-bound parameters, and internal-only refactors.

The reviewer prompt code-review-surface-parity.md must exist, enumerate the three write surfaces, direct the reviewer to grep sibling adapters for changed params/guards, and maintain coherence with the deletion-impact and api-compat contract (evidence-record findings, criteria=["surface-parity"], model-emitted severity absent).

The base-reviewer overlay catalog in code-review-base.md must list surface-parity to keep the drift test test_base_prompt_enumerates_exactly_the_overlay_ids green and in exact lockstep with OVERLAY_IDS.

The reviewers/index.json must remain unchanged (overlays with category code-review-pass are excluded from the selection catalog by design), and regenerate_prompt_index() must be a no-op to keep the drift gate green.
